verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Svelte's built-in Stores and Context system are used for sharing/global state without third-party libraries, but no first-party docs in this pack detail the store API, runes-based state ($state), or best practices for global state management. missing for 10: first-party documentation of stores/runes as global state primitives, detailed examples, independent tutorials confirming ease of use beyond a single community quote.
